fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/web -run 'TestWebPauseFormsCarryCSRFAndAreAbsentWithoutToken|TestWebPausePostsAndRefusesMissingCSRF|TestWebActionsOnly' shows the pause and resume forms carry the CSRF field and are absent when no token is set, pauses and resumes the daemon and a project through POST with the token and the CSRF field, refuses a pause or resume POST missing the CSRF field, and gets 404 or 405 for a POST to any other path, retry, abandon and merge included; go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestWebPauseAction shows a POST through WebProjectHandler and WebRootHandler writes rhiza.daemon.paused and the named project's rhiza.project.paused through daemon.set.
fields.statement: From the web UI the owner pauses or resumes the daemon or one project (rhiza.daemon.paused, rhiza.project.paused), and no other action exists: every other POST path is refused.
